2.5.1.5-f10.left_anchor: : so saith Horace, so saith Anacreon,
2.5.1.5-f10.right_anchor: Let’s drive down care with a cup of wine: and so say
2.5.1.5-f10.text: Drink, then, while we may, For Death is on his way.

2.5.1.5-f17.left_anchor: and Amber in some cases. Alkermes comforts the inner parts; and Bezoar-stone
2.5.1.5-f17.right_anchor: To Bezoar-stone most subscribe, Monardus, and many others, it takes away sadness,
